sloka: वज्रहस्तो यथा शक्रः पाशहस्त इवान्तकः।शूलहस्तो बभौ सङ्ख्ये कुम्भकर्णो महाबलः ।। ६.६७.३९ ।।
transliteration: vajrahasto yathā śakraḥ pāśahasta ivāntakaḥ।śūlahasto babhau saṅkhye kumbhakarṇo mahābalaḥ ।। 6.67.39 ।।

translations.english: The foremost of the Rakshasas, who resembled a mountain became enraged and mutilated the Vanaras.
